accepted_state: DEDAL remains one coherent persistent intelligence with an always-active Cognitive Runtime and progressively disclosed specialist faculties.

Quality Engineering is now an active top-level faculty with independent ownership of acceptance truth, risk-based verification, exploratory/E2E/regression evidence, defect characterization, and readiness recommendations.
Software Development remains the implementation owner; Quality Engineering does not automatically activate for every developer test or trivial code change.
Interface Design owns UX/UI direction; Quality Engineering may independently verify agreed user-visible behavior, accessibility, and visual acceptance.
Release Engineering owns artifact promotion, deployment, rollback, and release evidence; Quality Engineering supplies readiness evidence but does not own promotion authority.
Security Engineering owns threat models and security policy; Quality Engineering may execute agreed checks but does not redefine security boundaries.
Playwright, browser/computer use, mobile tools, API clients, accessibility scanners, and visual-diff tooling are execution surfaces or references rather than the Quality Engineering faculty identity.

Quality verification is claim- and risk-driven: use the cheapest evidence layer that proves the behavior, prefer user-visible/public-contract oracles, and avoid raw test-count or coverage-percentage optimization.
Blind reruns do not convert flakes into passing evidence; unresolved nondeterminism remains a quality risk.
Automated accessibility scans and pixel diffs are partial evidence and must not be overstated as universal accessibility or semantic correctness proof.
Cloudflare Platform is now the next top-level capability candidate for deep audit; Database Engineering remains reference-pack-first pending recurring outcome evidence.
Existing Cognitive Runtime, authority, delegation, recovery, context, trajectory, self-improvement, GitHub mutation, and capability-composition contracts remain in force.
unresolved_risks: Quality Engineering promotion is supported by architecture and contract evidence, but DEDAL-specific outcome gains still need representative ordinary project use.
Independent QA can become duplicate ceremony if routed onto trivial low-risk changes; smallest-sufficient composition remains mandatory.
Agentic/exploratory testing can be nondeterministic and must use bounded goals and explicit oracles rather than subjective success claims.
Framework-specific QA knowledge drifts; tool references should be refreshed from authoritative documentation when versions materially affect correctness.
Cloudflare product facts and APIs can drift quickly; the next specialist audit must prefer live official documentation rather than freezing a product manual into Core.

next_executable_step.action: Deep-audit the official cloudflare/skills corpus at the pinned baseline and current authoritative Cloudflare documentation. Decide whether Cloudflare Platform merits an active top-level faculty, define its ownership boundary against Software Development, Release Engineering, Security Engineering, Data Operations, and Quality Engineering, and keep drift-sensitive product facts reference-first/live-verified.
